13119.water_body: on-site fishing pond (unnamed); Skin Creek drainage
13119.note: Operator advertises a stocked catch-and-release fishing pond, but Esri imagery is fully leafed-out and no open water is visible anywhere on the property; sites read as scattered under canopy along an interior gravel road set well back from the highway rather than ringed around water.

13120.note: Operator advertises swimming and fishing in Patterson Creek and 'permanent waterfront lodging'; on Esri imagery the creek runs along the campground's east/southeast edge and the easternmost row of sites sits roughly 30-60 m from it behind a wooded screen, while the two western rows are 100 m or more back in open field.

13121.water_body: unnamed creek in the hollow; on-site fishing ponds per the Greenbrier County CVB listing
13121.note: The CVB listing mentions a 'fresh mountain creek' and fishing ponds; on Esri imagery a wooded drainage runs between the two camping lanes down the hollow and no open water is visible at pad level, so any pond is small and under canopy.

13122.water_body: Ohio River (distant); operator says the property borders the Ohio River Islands National Wildlife Refuge at Captina Island
13122.note: The sites sit inland in a wooded hollow with the golf course between them and the river - on Esri imagery the Ohio is roughly 700 m west beyond the fairways and a rail line, with no water visible at pad level. Treat the refuge-boundary claim as a property-line fact, not a shoreline one.
